test_title: PYST 02: SSC JE ME - General Intelligence (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A − B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’ and

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

How is B related to T if ‘B + D − G ÷ P × T’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Husband
 Sister
 Mother
 
 

 

Given: B + D - G ÷ P × T

It means: B is the brother of D, D is the husband of G, G is the mother of P, and P is the sister of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9cb5131437b2950a181ac4d8e72a8ea6ffd8cf55cd0d632fec289541c34b652.png] 

So, B is the father’s brother of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
